== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Ommni Box (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Ommni Box]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ds-ommni-box/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ds_Ommni_Box.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>c24a4c2e1f5de01dc4b8daa580cc599ef9670c0da50d23be41559680ca88ba7e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
